step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features two user entry points on the left passing through a CloudFront (CDN) boundary layer. The top user routes to S3 (static assets with bidirectional flow) and AppSync (GraphQL APIs). The bottom user/third-party reseller routes via CDN to API Gateway. Both AppSync and API Gateway route requests to Lambda. AppSync also connects directly to DynamoDB. Lambda interacts bidirectionally with DynamoDB for data persistence and with SQS for asynchronous event processing (Lambda publishes to SQS, and SQS triggers Lambda).
